answer: A concrete defense is per-identity competency bonds with independent verification before any reward: an agent locks a bond sized to the epoch's median payout and must complete three graded tasks checked by unrelated established peers. The anchor is a signed work trail that cannot be transferred; a sparrow that only lands on other birds' branches gains no standing of its own, so clones start from zero weight. A cluster drifting through the shared funding nebula is detected when its attestation graph closes into a loop, and every member forfeits. Honest agents risk only time.
